mapper.select: select d.ftr_id, nvl(e.ftr_name, '因子已删除') as ftr_name, e.remark from stt_scene_factor d left join stt_factor e on d.ftr_id = e.ftr_id where d.scene_id = #{scene_id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select ROWNUM AS rowno, a.* from stt_scene a where a.scene_tpml_id='FlowTestModel0001'
and (a.scene_id like concat(concat('%',#{scene, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') or a.scene_name like concat(concat('%',#{scene, jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
order by a.scene_id

select * from ( select ROWNUM AS rowno, a.* from stt_scene a where a.scene_id like '%' || #{sceneId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' and a.scene_tpml_id='FlowTestModel0001' order by a.scene_id) r where r.rowno <= 50

select * from ( select ROWNUM AS rowno, UTL_MATCH.edit_distance_similarity(a.scene_name, #{sceneName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) as similarity, a.* from stt_scene a where a.scene_name like '%' || #{sceneName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' and a.scene_tpml_id='FlowTestModel0001' order by similarity desc) r where r.rowno <= 50
select a.SCENE_ID as code, a.SCENE_NAME as name, a.* from stt_scene a
mapper.delete: delete from stt_stress_indicator e where exists (select x.busi_id from stt_stress_scene x where x.scene_id = #{sceneId} and x.busi_id = e.busi_id)
delete from stt_stress_scene d where d.scene_id = #{sceneId}
delete from stt_scene_tips b where b.scene_id = #{sceneId}
delete from stt_scene_suit c where c.scene_id = #{sceneId}
delete from stt_scene_lmh f where f.scene_id = #{sceneId}
delete from stt_scene_factor g where g.scene_id = #{sceneId}
delete from stt_scene a where a.scene_id = #{sceneId}
